They struggle to get rid of unwanted crocodiles; they're afraid of wrestling with them and they don't want to be seen to be 'unkind' to the local crocs.
They believe the Crocs will just get tired of hanging around and will move on their own at some stage anyway.
We deal with the whole process; we organise the permits, the transportation, the sanctuary loading fees - all in one simple bundled service offer.

Who We Work With (Your target market or ‘A’ clients, if you prefer)
We specialise in helping 'croc-infested' home owners in the Orange County district.
Our One Big Promise (What they can expect to enjoy IF they deal with you- summed up in one brief sentence)
"Poof! - and the big bad Croc is gone! (for good)"

A.- Improved re-sales Values b.- Reduced Public Liability Premiums c.- Increased visits from Friends & Family

We make a plaster cast of the croc's feet, you can show your friends you had a visitor :) AND - We spread payments over 3 months and we file the 'crocodile removal' permit on your behalf - (saving you the hassle of dealing with local council) If the croc comes back - we remove it again for free.
How We Work with Our Clients:

We dangle Robert (one of our trained employees) from a large pole until the big crocs come rushing to grab him. Then, we leap out from behind the bushes and wrestle the croc to the ground. When we're done, we take a photo, a plaster cast of the croc's foot and sweep the drive before we go.
The Magic Happens When (What your client needs to do to allow you to do your ‘best work’ - ‘their part in achieving excellence, if you prefer)

The magic happens when our customers show us the croc and then leave on a 2 day holiday. This way, we can lay a trap free from the concern of our customer wandering into the middle of things and getting stuck in the croc's throat...
The Big What & The Big Why (The common problem/s or opportunity/s [you deal with] and why it has relevance to them)
Due to global warming, crocodiles now look to sleep in the lounge or bathtub of homeowners. This raises stress in the home and is a slight health risk.
Why You Do What You Do (What drives you to provide your product or service - Why you care…)
My grandfather was a crocodile hunter and my best friend got eaten by one when he jumped in his shower cubicle. I never want another person to feel threatened by a crocodile in their own home again.
It’s A Bit Like… (Your ‘Metaphor Story’ that helps people understand the problem/opportunity or any technical issue that causes confusion or slows the sales process)

It's a bit like wearing your seatbelt in your car; you don't expect to have a crash every time you drive and in fact, may go years without incident but if luck goes against you, it's the difference between life and death...
How You Make Buying Easy (What ‘Risk Removal’ or Guarantee you offer; How you make payment/ selection / collection easy)

We take all major credit cards; you can enjoy our mthly payment plan for regular service and if we find a crocodile in your home, we'll transport it straight to a treatment centre for wayward crocodiles. You never have to meet it face to face but we will show photographic proof if requested.
